subject: MAP: finalize GPU pool sizing & Dedicated/Private lead times for Aurelia
messages:
From: Paul King <paul.king@aureliasys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurelia Systems Procurement <procurement@aureliasys.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kick off MAP + capacity needs for POC -> Prod

Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We'd like to move forward with a formal Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to cover the POC (evaluation) and the anticipated production reservation. High level:

- POC: 6 weeks evaluation (approx. 3 devs + 1 integration engineer), target latency <= 120ms for 2k concurrent small-batch requests.
- Prod reservation: start with a 16-GPU pool (A100 equivalent), scale to 48 GPUs within 12 weeks if the POC meets performance targets.
- Compliance: we need confirmable audit evidence (SOC 2) and an on-prem/private option for sensitive ML artifacts.

I've attached an initial requirements pack (aurelia_map_draft_v3.pdf) with expected traffic shapes and data retention constraints. Can your team outline lead times for Dedicated vs Private deployments, and a suggested tranche-based commit schedule?

Thanks,
Paul King
Head of AI Platform
Aurelia Systems

Attachment: aurelia_map_draft_v3.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Paul King <paul.king@aureliasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick off MAP + capacity needs for POC -> Prod

Paul — thanks for the clear brief and the attachment. We've reviewed it and sketched an initial MAP. At a high level:

- Evaluation (weeks 0–6): Dedicated hosted eval on a 4-GPU compact pool to validate latency and throughput with your test harness.
- Scale plan (weeks 6–18): staged tranches, commit 16 GPUs at close (tranche 1), add 16 GPUs week 8 (tranche 2), remaining 16 GPUs week 12 if SLA targets met.
- Lead times: Dedicated (hosted/reserved) typical provisioning 4–6 weeks from signed reservation; Private (VPC or on-prem agent) 8–10 weeks due to network & KMS integrations.

I've attached a draft MAP we can iterate on (attached: aurelia_map_draft_v3.pdf). Can Ben run sizing sims against your traffic profile and Karthik validate the acceptance criteria for KV-cache and prefix caching to preserve latency under batching?

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: aurelia_map_draft_v3.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Paul King <paul.king@aureliasys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick off MAP + capacity needs for POC -> Prod

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 11:04 AM Hannah Schmitt wrote:
> Hannah — thanks for the clear brief and the attachment. We've reviewed it and sketched an initial MAP.

Attached is a sizing workbook (gpu_capacity_modeling.xlsx) with three scenarios: conservative, target, and aggressive. Quick notes from the sims:

- Baseline small-batch throughput per A100-equivalent: ~1,800 tokens/sec under continuous batching assumptions.
- For Aurelia's peak (2k concurrent small-batch), the target scenario maps to ~28 GPUs to keep p95 latency under 120ms with 4 worker distribution.
- Suggest starting with 20 GPUs for tranche 1 (gives headroom for traffic spikes) and commit to a timed scale (to 40 GPUs) on week 8 post-close if eval metrics pass.

I'll need your simulated QPS/sequence-length distribution to tighten the numbers.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: gpu_capacity_modeling.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Paul King <paul.king@aureliasys.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick off MAP + capacity needs for POC -> Prod

Paul — appreciate the timeline context. A couple procurement/contract points to flag early:

- Pricing & tranches: we can structure a staged commit with a 12-month reservation starting at tranche 1 (20 GPUs) and subsequent tranches billed as add-on capacity with pre-defined scale windows.
- Private/VPC on-prem onboarding typically requires SOC2 evidence & network validation; plan 8–10 weeks lead time. We'll provide an audit checklist to streamline.
- Acceptance criteria: recommend a formal eval gating doc (prometheus traces + p95 latency + correctness tests). If all pass, tranche 2 triggers automatically; if not, we hold and run a remediation sprint.

Attaching a short audit checklist to help procurement (audit_checklist.zip).

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success & Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: audit_checklist.zip

From: Paul King <paul.king@aureliasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick off MAP + capacity needs for POC -> Prod

Marissa / Hannah —

Thanks — procurement has long internal lead times and they prefer staged financials. The proposed tranche/commit model works for us if we can get the Private deployment option validated before tranche 2. Two asks from our side:

1) Can you produce a canary rollout plan that includes rollback criteria and runbook owners?
2) Do you have a standard DocuSign template for the reservation tranches so we can route faster through procurement?

If you can get the canary plan and the DocuSign envelope, we can aim to sign tranche 1 by the end of next week and start provisioning.

— Paul

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Paul King <paul.king@aureliasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick off MAP + capacity needs for POC -> Prod

Paul — great, we are aligned on the high-level MAP. Summary & next actions (finalizing MAP doc this morning and will update the Drive link):

- Tranche 1 (commit + sign): 20 GPUs (reserved, 12-month), target in-provisioning 4–6 weeks post-signature. Owner: Marissa.
- Eval window: Weeks 0–6 on a 4–8 GPU sandbox with Redwood-managed monitoring. Owner: Ben. Gate: p95 latency <= 120ms and correctness suite pass.
- Canary & rollout plan: Karthik will provide a canary runbook (rollout steps, rollback criteria, monitoring playbook) by Thu 05 May 2027. Owner: Karthik.
- Private deployment validation: security checklist & SOC2 artifacts delivered by Marissa; expected validation 6–8 weeks once network info is shared. Owner: Marissa / Aurelia procurement.
- DocuSign & commercial: Marissa to send the tranche 1 DocuSign envelope by Wed 05 May 2027. HubSpot deal updated: DL-2027-089.

Onwards: I'll share the updated MAP (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4dMAP) and schedule a 30-min checkpoint for Thu 06 May to confirm signature path.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
